verdict.rationale: GitHub evidence directly references an official upgrade guide for moving between versions, but there's no detail on coverage of major-to-major incompatible breaking changes, and community feedback (angular-comm-4) notes historical pain around the AngularJS→Angular2 transition not being backward compatible, suggesting migration friction existed. missing for 10: first-party docs excerpt detailing the migration guide's content/steps, independent confirmation that the guide adequately covers incompatible major version jumps, and resolution of the historical complaint about lack of compatibility.
